form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital fillable form, typed figures. This is a LATER revision of the modern form than a14994b8's v. 4.20: the report-type list adds an 'End-of-Year Report' option, the affirmation block is labelled 'Affirmation' (not a second 'Type of Report'), the cover adds a 'Date of Filing' box (5/9/2022), and the Balance at Close box is lettered 'G'. No version string is printed in the footer. The Office field reads 'Auditor' (index.csv says 'County Auditor' - naming convention only). Address/city/state/zip are redacted upstream by the county (black bar), so residence_city is ''; the signature itself is NOT redacted on this filing. The summary page's own 'Name of Candidate' and 'Date of Report' boxes were left blank by the filer; report_date is taken from the cover page signature/filing date.

notes: The chunk listed pages 4 and 5 as summary pages, but page 5 is the county's internal 'Campaign Financial Disclosure Checklist' (two staff review sign-offs dated 5/18/2022), not a second report. ONE report only; page 4 is the sole Summary Page.
